name: Jasaw Chan Kʼawiil I
contribution: An ajaw of the Maya city of Tikal.

checks.lead: Jasaw Chan Kʼawiil I also known as Ruler A, Ah Cacao and Sky Rain (before 682–734), was an ajaw of the Maya city of Tikal. He took the throne on 3 May 682, and reigned until his death.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
